exposure: Non-use of WHO surgical safety checklist
cohort: 979 pregnant mothers who underwent caesarean section at Tibebe Ghion Specialized Hospital in North-West Ethiopia between June 2019 and June 2021.
finding: Maternal bleeding and not using the WHO surgical safety checklist were independently associated with an increased risk of 7-day perioperative maternal mortality following caesarean section.
mod_finding: The 7-day perioperative maternal mortality rate for mothers undergoing caesarean section was 1.83%.
